Game Overview

In Animal Connect, the core idea is straightforward: race against time in Animal Connect, a whimsical puzzle adventure where you match charming animal tiles. Strategize your moves to clear the board, testing your speed and wits. Enjoy a visually delightful experience that sharpens your mind while offering a fun, relaxing challenge for players of all ages.
